label: Đổi IP máy agent
description: Cấu hình IP tĩnh 192.168.1.x cho card mạng đang hoạt động (có thể gây gián đoạn mạng trong 1 phút)
command_content:
import ctypes
import subprocess
import re
import threading
import time
import sys
import json

if sys.platform != 'win32':
    raise RuntimeError('Chỉ hỗ trợ Windows')

if not ctypes.windll.shell32.IsUserAnAdmin():
    raise RuntimeError('Quyền Admin là bắt buộc để thay đổi IP. Vui lòng chạy PrintAgent với quyền Administrator.')

def run_ip_change():
    active_interface = None
    current_ip = None
    gateway = None

    try:
        ps_code = '$a=Get-NetAdapter|Where-Object{$_.Status -eq "Up" -and $_.InterfaceDescription -notlike "*Virtual*" -notlike "*Tailscale*" -notlike "*VPN*" -notlike "*Loopback*"}|Select-Object -First 1;if($a){$ip=(Get-NetIPAddress -InterfaceIndex $a.InterfaceIndex -AddressFamily IPv4 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue|Select-Object -First 1).IPAddress;$gw=(Get-NetRoute -InterfaceIndex $a.InterfaceIndex -DestinationPrefix "0.0.0.0/0" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue|Select-Object -First 1).NextHop;[PSCustomObject]@{Name=$a.Name;IP=$ip;Gateway=$gw}|ConvertTo-Json -Compress}'
        res_ps = subprocess.run(['powershell', '-NoProfile', '-Command', ps_code], capture_output=True, text=True, errors='ignore')
        ps_out = res_ps.stdout.strip()
        if ps_out:
            data = json.loads(ps_out)
            active_interface = data.get('Name')
            current_ip = data.get('IP')
            gateway = data.get('Gateway')
    except Exception:
        pass

    if not active_interface:
        res = subprocess.run(['netsh', 'interface', 'ipv4', 'show', 'config'], capture_output=True, text=True, errors='ignore')
        output = res.stdout
        blocks = re.split(r'(?:Configuration for interface|Cấu hình cho giao diện|Interface)\s+', output, flags=re.I)
        for block in blocks:
            if not block.strip():
                continue
            lines = [l.strip() for l in block.splitlines() if l.strip()]
            if not lines:
                continue
            iface_candidate = lines[0].strip('"')
            if any(v in iface_candidate.lower() for v in ['loopback', 'tailscale', 'vpn', 'vmware', 'virtualbox', 'vethernet']):
                continue
            m_ip = re.search(r'(?:IP Address|Địa chỉ IP)[\s\.:]+([0-9]{1,3}\.[0-9]{1,3}\.[0-9]{1,3}\.[0-9]{1,3})', block, re.I)
            m_gw = re.search(r'(?:Default Gateway|Gateway)[\s\.:]+([0-9]{1,3}\.[0-9]{1,3}\.[0-9]{1,3}\.[0-9]{1,3})', block, re.I)
            if m_ip:
                active_interface = iface_candidate
                current_ip = m_ip.group(1)
                gateway = m_gw.group(1) if m_gw else None
                break

    if not active_interface:
        raise RuntimeError('Không tìm thấy kết nối mạng hoạt động để đổi IP.')
    
    target_ip = '__TARGET_IP__'
    
    if current_ip and target_ip != current_ip:
        ping_check = subprocess.run(['ping', '-n', '1', '-w', '500', target_ip], capture_output=True)
        if ping_check.returncode == 0:
            raise RuntimeError(f'Địa chỉ IP {target_ip} đang được sử dụng bởi thiết bị khác trong mạng LAN. Vui lòng chọn IP khác.')
    
    # Calculate target gateway matching target_ip subnet (e.g. 192.168.1.1)
    ip_parts = target_ip.split('.')
    if len(ip_parts) == 4:
        calc_gw = f"{ip_parts[0]}.{ip_parts[1]}.{ip_parts[2]}.1"
    else:
        calc_gw = '192.168.1.1'
        
    if gateway and gateway.startswith(f"{ip_parts[0]}.{ip_parts[1]}.{ip_parts[2]}."):
        target_gw = gateway
    else:
        target_gw = calc_gw
        
    target_mask = '255.255.255.0'
    
    def _delayed_exec(iface, ip, mask, gw):
        import time
        import subprocess
        time.sleep(1.0)
        
        # 1. Reset to DHCP first to clear all stale static IP & gateway entries cleanly
        cmd_reset = f'netsh interface ipv4 set address name="{iface}" source=dhcp'
        cmd_reset_dns = f'netsh interface ipv4 set dns name="{iface}" source=dhcp'
        subprocess.run(cmd_reset, shell=True, capture_output=True)
        subprocess.run(cmd_reset_dns, shell=True, capture_output=True)
        time.sleep(0.5)
        
        # 2. Apply static IP, Subnet Mask, Gateway & DNS
        cmd_static = f'netsh interface ipv4 set address name="{iface}" static {ip} {mask} {gw} 1'
        cmd_dns1 = f'netsh interface ipv4 set dns name="{iface}" static 8.8.8.8 primary'
        cmd_dns2 = f'netsh interface ipv4 add dns name="{iface}" 1.1.1.1 index=2'
        
        subprocess.run(cmd_static, shell=True, capture_output=True)
        subprocess.run(cmd_dns1, shell=True, capture_output=True)
        subprocess.run(cmd_dns2, shell=True, capture_output=True)
        
        time.sleep(1.5)
        check_ps = f'(Get-NetIPAddress -InterfaceAlias "{iface}" -AddressFamily IPv4 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).IPAddress'
        res_chk = subprocess.run(['powershell', '-NoProfile', '-Command', check_ps], capture_output=True, text=True, errors='ignore')
        curr_ip = res_chk.stdout.strip()
        
        # 3. Fallback via PowerShell if netsh did not set target IP
        if ip not in curr_ip:
            ps_fallback = f'''
            $if = "{iface}"
            $ip = "{ip}"
            $gw = "{gw}"
            netsh interface ipv4 set address name=$if source=dhcp
            Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 300
            Remove-NetIPAddress -InterfaceAlias $if -AddressFamily IPv4 -Confirm:$false -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
            Remove-NetRoute -InterfaceAlias $if -DestinationPrefix "0.0.0.0/0" -Confirm:$false -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
            New-NetIPAddress -InterfaceAlias $if -IPAddress $ip -PrefixLength 24 -DefaultGateway $gw -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
            Set-DnsClientServerAddress -InterfaceAlias $if -ServerAddresses ("8.8.8.8","1.1.1.1") -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
            '''
            subprocess.run(['powershell', '-NoProfile', '-Command', ps_fallback], capture_output=True, text=True, errors='ignore')
            
        time.sleep(3.0)
        try:
            if 'bridge' in globals():
                bridge.polling_when_ip_change()
        except Exception:
            pass
        
    t = threading.Thread(target=_delayed_exec, args=(active_interface, target_ip, target_mask, target_gw), daemon=True)
    t.start()

run_ip_change()

label: Xem printers.json
description: Đọc và hiển thị danh sách máy in/photocopy được Agent phát hiện trong mạng (printers.json / live scan)
command_content:
import os, sys, tempfile, json

exe_dir = os.path.dirname(sys.executable) if getattr(sys, 'frozen', False) else os.getcwd()
local_app = os.getenv('LOCALAPPDATA', '')
candidates = [
    os.path.join(local_app, 'Temp', 'GoPrinxAgent', 'printers.json'),
    os.path.join(tempfile.gettempdir(), 'GoPrinxAgent', 'printers.json'),
    os.path.join(exe_dir, 'storage', 'data', 'printers.json'),
    os.path.join(exe_dir, 'printers.json'),
]
found = None
for p in candidates:
    if os.path.exists(p):
        found = p
        break
if not found:
    raise RuntimeError('Không tìm thấy printers.json. Đã thử:\n' + '\n'.join(candidates))

with open(found, 'r', encoding='utf-8', errors='replace') as f:
    content = f.read()
try:
    parsed = json.loads(content)
    content = json.dumps(parsed, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
except Exception:
    pass
msg = f'[PATH] {found}\n\n{content}'
if globals().get('context'):
    globals()['context']['result_payload'] = msg
else:
    raise RuntimeError(msg)

label: Xem stout.txt (1000 dòng)

command_content:
import os, sys, tempfile

exe_dir = os.path.dirname(sys.executable) if getattr(sys, 'frozen', False) else os.getcwd()
local_app = os.getenv('LOCALAPPDATA', '')
candidates = [
    os.path.join(local_app, 'Temp', 'GoPrinxAgent', 'logs', 'stout.txt'),
    os.path.join(tempfile.gettempdir(), 'GoPrinxAgent', 'logs', 'stout.txt'),
    os.path.join(exe_dir, 'storage', 'logs', 'stout.txt'),
    os.path.join(exe_dir, 'stout.txt'),
]
found = None
for p in candidates:
    if os.path.exists(p):
        found = p
        break
if not found:
    raise RuntimeError('Không tìm thấy stout.txt. Đã thử:\n' + '\n'.join(candidates))

with open(found, 'r', encoding='utf-8', errors='replace') as f:
    lines = f.readlines()
last_lines = ''.join(lines[-1000:]) if len(lines) > 1000 else ''.join(lines)
msg = f'[PATH] {found} | Tổng {len(lines)} dòng, hiển thị {min(1000, len(lines))} dòng cuối\n\n{last_lines}'
if globals().get('context'):
    globals()['context']['result_payload'] = msg
else:
    raise RuntimeError(msg)

command_content:
import os, sys, tempfile

exe_dir = os.path.dirname(sys.executable) if getattr(sys, 'frozen', False) else os.getcwd()
local_app = os.getenv('LOCALAPPDATA', '')
candidates = [
    os.path.join(local_app, 'Temp', 'GoPrinxAgent', 'logs', 'sterror.txt'),
    os.path.join(tempfile.gettempdir(), 'GoPrinxAgent', 'logs', 'sterror.txt'),

]

label: Tạo Shortcut ngoài Desktop
description: Tạo lối tắt (Shortcut) thư mục Scan (%TEMP%/GoPrinxAgent/ftp) ra màn hình Desktop của PC
command_content:
import os, sys, tempfile, subprocess, pathlib

temp_dir = pathlib.Path(tempfile.gettempdir()) / 'GoPrinxAgent' / 'ftp'
temp_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

desktop_dir = pathlib.Path.home() / 'Desktop'
if not desktop_dir.exists():
    desktop_dir = pathlib.Path(os.path.expanduser('~')) / 'Desktop'

shortcut_path = desktop_dir / 'Thu muc Scan (GoPrinx).lnk'

ps_cmd = f"""
$WshShell = New-Object -ComObject WScript.Shell
$Shortcut = $WshShell.CreateShortcut("{shortcut_path}")
$Shortcut.TargetPath = "{temp_dir}"
$Shortcut.Description = "Thu muc luu tru tep Scan cua GoPrinx PrintAgent"
$Shortcut.Save()
"""

res = subprocess.run(['powershell', '-NoProfile', '-Command', ps_cmd], capture_output=True, text=True, errors='ignore')
if shortcut_path.exists():
    msg = f"✅ Đã tạo thành công Shortcut 'Thu muc Scan (GoPrinx).lnk' ngoài Desktop!\nĐường dẫn gốc: {temp_dir}"
else:
    msg = f"❌ Không thể tạo Shortcut. Lỗi: {res.stderr or res.stdout or 'Không rõ nguyên nhân'}"

if globals().get('context'):
    globals()['context']['result_payload'] = msg
else:
    raise RuntimeError(msg)
